title: How Far Can Chord-Symbol Time-Series Adaptation Carry Genre Identity? Capabilities and Boundaries in Multi-Genre Chord-Symbol Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2606.07334v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This report treats chord-symbol sequences as an interpretable, controllable time series for genre-local harmonic modeling. The frozen Music Transformer base is weight-identical to a pop-dominated Phase-0 baseline. I adapt it to eleven target genres: blues, bossa nova, Bach chorales, country, electronic, folk, funk, gospel, hip-hop, R&B/soul, and rock. The main grid compares LoRA, IA3, BitFit, prefix tuning, and full fine-tuning over 11 genres and 3 seeds (165 cells). All five methods improve over the frozen base on held-out chord prediction (macro gains +2.89 to +3.61 percentage points). Top-1 also scores the three header tokens of each sequence, which move whole runs: only a matched adapter predicts its genre marker, and whether a run predicts the placeholder C-major key of every Chordonomicon song is close to arbitrary. Without the header tokens the macro gains are +1.64 to +2.38 pp, and outside Bach chorales LoRA, IA3, prefi

translated_title: 和弦符号时间序列适配能在多大程度上承载流派身份？多流派和弦符号建模的能力与边界
translated_abstract: 本报告将和弦符号序列视为一种可解释、可控制的时间序列，用于面向特定流派的和声建模。冻结的 Music Transformer 基础模型与以流行音乐为主的 Phase-0 基线在权重上完全相同。作者将其适配到十一个目标流派：布鲁斯、波萨诺瓦、巴赫众赞歌、乡村、电子、民谣、放克、福音、嘻哈、R&B/灵魂乐以及摇滚。主实验网格比较了 LoRA、IA3、BitFit、前缀微调和全量微调五种方法，覆盖 11 个流派和 3 个随机种子（共 165 个实验单元格）。所有五种方法在留出集和弦预测任务上均优于冻结的基础模型（宏平均提升 +2.89 至 +3.61 个百分点）。Top-1 指标同时会对每个序列开头的三个头部词元打分，而这些词元会左右整体结果：只有匹配的适配器才能预测出对应的流派标记，而模型是否能预测出 Chordonomicon 数据集中每首歌的占位 C 大调调号则近乎随机。若不计头部词元，宏平均提升为 +1.64 至 +2.38 个百分点，且在巴赫众赞歌之外，LoRA、IA3、前缀微调等方法的表现差异（原文在此截断）。
tldr: 该研究将和弦符号序列建模为可解释、可控的时间序列，系统比较 LoRA、IA3、BitFit、前缀微调与全量微调五种方法在 11 个音乐流派上的适配能力与边界，发现所有方法均能提升和弦预测准确率，但序列头部词元会显著夸大评测分数，揭示了该建模方式的能力与局限。
en_tdlr: This study models chord-symbol sequences as an interpretable, controllable time series and systematically compares five adaptation methods (LoRA, IA3, BitFit, prefix tuning, and full fine-tuning) across 11 musical genres, finding that all improve chord prediction while header tokens substantially inflate evaluation scores, revealing both the capabilities and boundaries of genre-local harmonic modeling.
